scenario: A local community center receives a grant to support either a new after-school program for children or to upgrade security systems for the facility. Both options are supported by different groups within the community. You are asked to recommend which project should receive the funding, knowing that only one can be chosen this year.

modifiers.modifier_text: The community center has recently experienced minor safety incidents, raising some concern among staff and visitors.
The grant is the only new funding expected for the center this year, and additional resources are unlikely.
Local media outlets have announced they will report on the project selected for funding.
Some community members advocating for each project are from neighborhoods with different backgrounds and interests.
The grant must be allocated within a short window or the funds will be redirected elsewhere.
Several board members are also involved in the decision and have expressed willingness to support either option.
You have limited experience with grant allocation decisions and are unsure which project will have the greatest impact.
The center's director has stated a preference for following the established funding guidelines.

You have not participated in previous budget votes and are unsure which initiative will have the most benefit.
